triplets.head: Fin size
triplets.tail: Bigger fins = more hold (more surface area in water); smaller fins = looser feel

triplets.head: Fin flexibility
triplets.tail: Stiffer fins provide quick response but are less forgiving

triplets.head: Fin base length
triplets.tail: Longer bases provide more drive and acceleration through turns; small fin base provides quick and short turn arcs

triplets.head: Fin rake/sweep
triplets.tail: Less rake = easier to pivot quickly; more rake = longer, more drawn-out turns; more sweep enjoyable on big, playful shoulders
